title: SeatHoldExpired
description: Published by Seat Inventory Service HoldReconciliationScheduler when a HELD row is found past expires_at. Consumed by: Notification Service (push checkout-window-expired to customerId WebSocket room), Booking Service (saga timeout watchdog cross-check).

bookingId.description: Resolved from seat_holds table after Redis TTL expiry. Used by Notification Service to push checkout-window-expired to the customer WebSocket room.

customerId.description: Resolved from seat_holds table. Required by Notification Service for userId-scoped WebSocket room routing.

expiredAt.description: UTC timestamp when the hold TTL was detected as expired by the reconciliation scheduler.
